diagnosis: Ulysses MPU aliases SP rank as MP rank, but only one replicated model checkpoint is written. DeepSpeed 0.18.2 checkpoint loader uses the SP alias as an index into a one-entry checkpoint list, failing on SP ranks above zero. Optimizer checkpoint naming likewise mixes SP aliases with DP partition ranks.
expected_fix_under_validation: Official released DeepSpeed 0.19.9 adds checkpoint_mp_rank based on actual model-parallel world size; both candidate and reference will use the same separate dependency prefix. No checkpoint file copying or manual state repair is performed.
